# awscontrib_connect_phone_number (Data Source)

Looks up an Amazon Connect phone number by its full E.164 number.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connect_instance_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Amazon Connect instance identifier or ARN."
}

variable "connect_phone_number" {
  type        = string
  description = "Full E.164 phone number to look up."
}

data "awscontrib_connect_phone_number" "example" {
  instance_id  = var.connect_instance_id
  phone_number = var.connect_phone_number
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier or ARN containing the phone number.
- `phone_number` (String) Full phone number in E.164 format.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Amazon Connect phone number ARN.
- `country_code` (String) ISO country code for the phone number.
- `description` (String) Phone number description, when configured.
- `id` (String) Amazon Connect phone number identifier.
- `source_phone_number_arn` (String) ARN of a phone number imported from an external service, when returned.
- `target_arn` (String) ARN of the Connect instance or traffic distribution group handling inbound traffic.
- `type` (String) Phone number type.
